journal_lines: Green bloom in the rock. Copper.
Blue-green tinge in the wall. Good sign.
Malachite in the stone. Copper vein behind it.
Aquamarine bloom on the surface. The vein ran deep.
Exposed copper face, oxidized green. Good sign of volume.
Copper whiskers along the joint. Traced them back.
The seam was thin but ran ten paces. Took all of it.
Blue staining in the crack. Found the body three feet in.
Two copper veins crossing. Took both.
Brassy metal smell before I found it. The vein was wide.
Streaked green and blue. Close-grained ore.
Dug through a dry passage and found the copper behind it.
The patina on the exposed face was thick. The ore behind it, fresh.
Copper-bearing stone heavier than expected. Good volume.
Found it following the calcite. Copper often near.
